scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend ci --ignore-scripts && npm --prefix frontend ci --ignore-scripts
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.test:unit: npm --prefix backend test -- --runInBand && npm --prefix frontend test -- --watch=false --browsers=ChromeHeadless
scripts.test:e2e: npm --prefix backend run test:e2e -- --runInBand && npm --prefix frontend run e2e
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint:check && npm --prefix frontend run lint:check
